name: Ten Ren Tea Co., Ltd.
summary: Ten Ren Tea Co., Ltd. is a company based in Taipei, Taiwan, with a legacy tracing back to its founding in 1953. It specializes in the global production and distribution of tea, various tea-related products, and a range of beverages, catering to both domestic and international markets. The company's business operations are primarily structured around two core segments: Tea, and Food and Beverage. In addition to its product offerings, Ten Ren Tea Co., Ltd. also extends its services to include catering. Its diverse portfolio of goods is marketed under several distinct brand names, such as Ten Ren Tea Culture Museum, CHAFFEE, cha FOR TEA ToGo, Ten Ren cha FOR TEA, and Ten Ren's Tea.
